༄༅/chu gtor gyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul mdor bsdus te bkod pa ltas chog bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/260)dpal ldan srid zhi'i khyab bdag ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ chu gtor gyi rim pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul mdor bsdus te bkod pa ltas chog bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo bzhugs so/ 260) dpal ldan srid zhi'i khyab bdag bla ma la// rtag tu mi phyed gus pas rab btud nas/ /dam pa'i gshegs shul chu sbyin bgyi ba'i tshul// mdor bsdus bltas chog bdag gis 'dir bkod bya/

/de la 'dir skyes bu gang zhig tshe 'di'i zas nor snyan grags lo 'dod sogs chos brgyad kyis bsam pa ma yin par/ bla med kyi byang chub dang gzhan phan kho na don du gnyer ba dag gis/ gnas gtsang zhing yid dang mthun par/ chab gtsang 'bu srin dang dhal rdul med pa ci 'byor dang*/ 'bru zan gyi ril bu brgya rtsa brgyad/ mchod pa'i zhal zas/ dzam la'i gtor ma dang bcas pa'am/ nas dang 'bras kyi 'bru sogs la'ang rung zhing rin po che'i gtor snod dang mchod pa'i yo byad 'dzoms pa'i ngang nas/ snying rje byang sems kyi bsam pa brtan pos stan bde la 'dug ste/ thog mar skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa spyi mthun ltar bya'am/ bsdus pa la spro na 'di ltar tshig don mthun pas/ na mo/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong la// rtag par skyabs mchi 'gro kun bde thob phyir// rgyal sras spyod pa bdag gis spyad par bgyi// sras bcas rgyal rnams 'dir bshegs dgyes par bzhugs// gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod tshogs 'bul// sdig 262) kun mthol bshags dge la yi rang ngo*// chos 'khor rgyun mi chad mdzad rtag bzhugs gsol// dge kun 'khor la dong sprug phyir bsngo'o// om̐ 'di ni dge sbyor gang byed brgya 'gyur du 'phel bar byed pa'i gzungs so/ wa shud+dhonyahaṃ/ phyi nang snod bcud stong zhing bdag med dang*/ rang nyid skad cig 'phags mchog thugs rje'i sku// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum dar dang rin chen rgyan// phyag g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pa pad dkar 'dzin// pad zla'i steng bzhugs 'od 'bar lham me ba'i// thugs kar hrīḥmathar yig drug bskor ba las// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med bstim// rigs lngas dbang bskur snang mthas dbu rgyan gyur// om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrīḥ sa gzhi dang gnas khang byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ sa gzhi gnas khang phyi

263) nang steng 'og kun// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las grub pa'i// bkod pa'i bye brag yid 'ongs mtha' yas pa// rgyal ba'i zhing mchog yon tan kun ldan gyur// mchod rdzas byin brlab ni/ om̐ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐/ om̐ swa bha wa shud+dha= stong gsum dang mnyam rin chen snod dag tu// sngags dang ting 'dzin 'du 'phro las byung ba'i// mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dpag med pa// rab 'byams rgyal ba mnyes byed mchog tu gyur// na ma sarba ta thā ga to bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛ h+ṇe daṃ bā l+ya di swā hāḥ gtor mgron rnams spyan drangs pa ni/ bdag nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas/ dkon mchog sri zhu mgon po yon tan dang*// rigs drug snying rje bgegs rigs lan chags sogs// mgron rnams spyan drangs so so'i gdan bzhugs gyur// badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ 264) pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyes sgrib skyon bral yang*// bdag sogs bsod nams tshogs rdzogs sgrib sbyang phyir// yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsis khrus gsol bas// 'gro ba'i las nyon sgrib tshogs dag gyur cig om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ yon chab me tog bdug spos mar me dri// zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg mtha' yas mchod tshogs rgya mtsho bdag 'bul gyi// bzhes nas 'gro kun thugs rjes skyabs su gsol// om̐ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai bi d+ya/ shap+ta pu dza me gha sa mu tra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ de ltar yul gong ma spyi la mchod pa'i rim pa sngon du btang nas/ mchod pa rnams gshegs shing*/ bshal chu ni gtor chu dang mi bsre bar phyi rol du dbo bar bya'o/ de nas bar 'dir chu sbyin nam/ gtor snod lnga po bshams te chu gtsang sbreng ba'i dang po de la/

bdag nyid 265) bcom ldan thugs rje chen po yi// phyag gi sor mo rtse nas bdud rtsi rgyun// rab tu babs pas yi dwags tshogs rnams kun// tshim pas longs spyad dga' bdes rgyud gang gyur// om̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ ces pas snod ma khengs bar du sbreng*/ snod gnyis pa de la lag g.yon mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ om̐ āḥhrī hūm̐/zhes pas khengs par sbreng*/ snod gsum par chu thig bcad cing blug la se gol dang bcas pas/ om̐ dza la i daṃ sarba pre te bh+yaḥswā hā/ snod bzhi par sbreng la/ 'phags mchog rgyal ba'i phyag nas legs 'ongs pa'i// yid 'ongs bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po la// yi dwags gaṅga'i klung gi bye snyed kun// khrus byas gdung ba kun bral bde thob shog /snod lnga par sbreng zhing*/ mgon po mi 'khrug pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ om̐ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni tro ṭa ni tro ṭa 266) ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pā raṃ pa rā ṇi mi sarba sa twa nañtsa swā hā/ sngags dang ting 'dzin bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis// tshe 'das bar dor 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba dag bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis ngom zhing tshim nas kyang*// sdug bsngal kun bral byang chub mchog thob shog de nas dzam+lā'i chu sbyin byed na/ gtor snod mtha' ma gnyis su dzam gser nag gnyis chu sbyin 'bul ba'i snod bya zhing*/ bar ma gnyis gtor ma'am ril bu'i snod dang*/ dbus ma mchod yon du bya phyir bshams la/ o badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags kyis bgegs bsangs/ o swa bha wa shu d+dhaḥ sogs/gtor ma'i nyes skyon 'bag rtsogs kun sbyangs shing*/ rin chen snod du 'bru gsum 'du 'phro yis// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med bdud rtsi mchog dngas shing thogs med mi zad dbyings khyab gyur// na maḥ

sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ om̐ sam+bha ra sa sam+bha ra hūm̐/ lan gsum/ om̐ āḥhūm̐/ gis gtor ma bdud rtsi byin gyis brlab/ pad nyi'i gdan steng hūm̐ mthing yongs gyur las// dzam nag khro tshul thod khrag ne'u le bsnams// sbrul brgyan dor stabs bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum las// 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs gnyis med thim// slar yang dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur bas// 269) bdud rtsis sku gang mi skyod dbu brgyan gyur// rang gi lag mthil gyi yig 'bru lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mnyes par bsam pas chu sbreng zhing*/ om̐ in+d+ra ni mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swā hā/ brgya nyer gcig bdun sogs dang*/ mchod yon sbreng zhing*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha dra ye/ ma hā yak+sha se na pa tā ye/ tad+ya thā/ om̐ dzam+bha la dza len dra ye swā hā/ dzam+bha la ar+ghaṃ/ pādh+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ gtor ma'i snod du chu sbreng zhing*/ dzam+bha la i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'di nor bdag khyed la phul zhing bstod bgyid pas/ bsam pa'i don kun chos ldan 'grub pa dang*/ dngos grub ma lus myur du stsal du gsol/ badz+ra muṃ/ zhes pas rang gnas su gshegs shing*/ mchod gtor bshags par bya'o/ de nas brgya rtsa dngos ni/ gtor snod lnga'am gcig gis kyang rung bar snod re re la ril 270) bu bcu bcu chu dang bcas pa bshams la/ so so la bsangs sbyar byin rlabs ni/ gong g-i dzam ser gyi skabs su byung ba ltar/ badz+ra a mṛ ta/ sogs nas sam+bhar bcu re dang*/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la rim pas 'bul zhing bcu tshan bzhi pa yan chad rnams la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis kyang mchod cing*/ lnga pa man chad ma ni de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan bsgrags pa dang*/ chos kyi sbyin pa yang rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ thog mar bcu tshan dang po ni/

byin rlabs sngon du 'gro bas/ rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas tshogs// 'phags mchog rnams la gtor mchod rgya mtsho'i sprin// gus pas phul bas bdag sogs 'gro kun la// brtse bas skyabs shing byin gyis brlab tu gsol// bcu tshan gnyis pa la/ sngar ltar byinalarlabs gzungs sngags dang*/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi mthar/ yi dam zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs rnams la// zag med bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul bas// 271) dngos grub kunastsol bar chad bsal du gsol// gsum pa yang sngar bzhin byin rlabs mchod pa sogs kyi mthar/ lha mi'i drang srong bden pa'i tshig grub cing*// rigs sngags 'chang ba mthu brnyes kun la yang*// zhal zas bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// skye 'gro bde ba'i smon lam mdzad du gsol// bzhi pa yang byin rlabs mchod sogs sngor bzhin byas la/ lhan skyes lha dang ye shes nor lha'i tshog ston pa'i dam chos skyong ba'i rigs rnams la// 'dod yon phun tshogs mchod gtor 'di phul bas// rgyal bstan yun ring gnas par mdzad du gsol// 'di man chad rnams la gzungs sngags kyi byin rlabs rnams gong bzhin las/ khyad par ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi don du de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan bsgrags te/ de bzhin bshegs pa rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la = bde bzhin bshegs pa sku 'byams klas la= de bzhin gshegs pa 272) 'jigs pa thams cad yongs su bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo// lha klu gnod sbyin dri za me rlung lha// srid na che bar rab grags mgon kun la// mchod sbyin bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'di 'bul gyi// bzhes nas 'jig rten bde bar mdzad du gsol// drug pa ni gong ltar gzungs dang mtshan rnams kyi mthar/ 'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par bod khams kyi// dge bsnyen bstan skyong dkar phyogs gzhi bdag tshogs// mchod sbyin gtor ma phul bas dgyes mdzod la// chos dang mthun pa'i sdong grogs mdzad du gsol//

bdun pa yang gong bzhin las/ 'jig rten lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// log 'dren gdon tshogs ma lus thams cad la// ji ltar 'dod pa'i longs spyod 'di sbyin pas// gnod cing 'tshe ba'i bsam sbyor bral bar mdzod// brgyad pa ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu// drin can pha mar gyur pa'i 'gro drug kun// zag med sbyin pa rgya chen 'dis tshim 273) zhing*// bla med byang chub myur du thob gyur cig / dgu pa ni/ bzod dka'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung yi dwags rigs// phyi nang sgo 'khyud sgrib pa can kun la// mi zad bdud rtsi'i char chen 'di phabs pas// 'dod yon longs spyod dpal la spyod par shog bcu pa ni/ tshe rabs 'di dang skye gzhan thams cad kyi// srog lus longs spyod bu lon sha 'khon can// lan chags re ltos gyur pa thams cad kyang*// mchod sbyin 'dis 'khor byang chub rgyur gyur cig de nas gtor snod gcig tu ril bu brgyad chu dang bcas pa bshams la/ gzungs dang byin rlabs mtshan grags pa sogs kyi mthar/ glo bur lhags pa'i mgron rigs nyam chung zhing*// khas nyen dbang chung snying rje'i yul gyur la// sbyin pa 'di bsngos ci 'dod tshim nas kyang*// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig de nas chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ de yang gong gi bcu tshan lnga pa man chad la re re bzhin so so'i mjug tu sbyar ba'am yang na thams cad kyi mjug 'dir bya ba ste/ 'di nyid kyang rgyas par ni/ chos thams cad rgyu las 'byung*// sogs dang*/ lus kyi sdom pa legs pa ste/ sogs kyi spyi ltar ram/ bsdus pa la spro na/ chos rnams ngo bo ye stong rtsa bral yang*// kun rdzob rgyu 'bras rten 'brel bslu med tshul// rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin blang dor shesabagyid dang*// gtan bde'i byang chub dam pa myur thob shog kun gyi thun mong du bden pa brjod pa ni/

sangs rgyas byang sems bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// drang srong rig 'dzin rnams kyi mthu nus dang*// bdag gi bsam pa rnam dag bden pa'i mthus// ji ltar bsngos bzhin thogs med 'byung gyur cig bzod gsol ni/ yo byad ma 'byor ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang*// gsang sngags ma dag nor 'khrul 'bag rtsogs sogs// lhag chad nyes skyon sgrib tshogs ci mchis pa// mgron rnams kun gyis bzod par bzhes su gsol// yig brgyas lhag chad kha skongs ba'ang rung ngo*/ gshegs gsol ni/ de ltar mchod sbyin bgyis pas kun tshim nas// 275) ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gnas su gshegs// lha srin sde brgyad 'byung tshogs ma lus kyang*// gnod bral rang rang gnas su myur du dengs// badz+ra muṃ/ sarba bhū ta gats+tsha/ bsngo ba ni/ sbyin pa 'dis mtshon tshe rabs thams cad kyi// dge tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu legs bsdom ste// ma rgan 'gro rnams sangs rgyas myur thob pa'i// rgyu nyid kho nar yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ smon lam ni/ tshe rabs kun tu bdag ni gar skyes kyang*// rgyal sras byang sems spyod pa rmad byung gis// 'gro la phan bde 'ba' shig sgrub byed pa'i// ded dpon dam pa nyid du 'gyur bar shog bkra shis ni/ phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas byang sems dang*/ dgongs brda' snyan rgyud bka' gter bshad sgrub sogs// skyabs gnas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi// byin rlabs sprin phungs 'khrig pa'i bkra shis shog gsal stong dbyings las 'gags med rang snang 'od// 276) rnam 'gyur du mas 'gro ba'i re 'dod skong*// yi dam zhi khro dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha// dngos grub char rgyun 'bebs pa'i bkra shis shog thugs rje'i klong las rang rtsal gar gyi bdag /log 'dren tshar gcod bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong*// phrin las thogs med mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs// mthu stobs glog stong 'gyu ba'i bkra shis shog

sangs rgyas bstan dar sems can bde zhing skyid// rnal 'byor chos 'phel 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi// rang don mthar phyin gzhan don lhun grub pas// phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog de ltar chu gtor gyi rim pa 'di ni gzhung gzhan nas kha bskang mi dgos par sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang zhing bltas chog tu byas pa zhig dgos zhes/ rig pa 'dzin pa tshul khrims bzangapo sogs don gnyer yang pos yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil du bkod pa 'disakyang 'gro ba rnams phan bde'i go 'phang bkod pa'i rkyen du gyur cig maṅga laṃ /
